description: This PHP class defines a validator for checking the existence of extensions (modules, themes, profiles) in Drupal, with support for different profiles and test environment detection.

classes.name: ExtensionAvailableConstraintValidator
classes.description: A validator class that checks if a specified extension (module, theme, profile) exists in Drupal, considering profiles and environment context.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor injecting extension list services, app root, install profile, and site path.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the validator with services from the container.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates whether a given extension name exists based on the specified constraint.

methods.name: extensionExists
methods.description: Checks if an extension of a given type and name exists, optionally using a discovery service.

methods.name: getExtensionDiscovery
methods.description: Retrieves or creates an ExtensionDiscovery object for a specific profile.

methods.name: resolveProfile
methods.description: Resolves the current profile name based on typed data, considering profile changes during validation.

methods.name: insideTest
methods.description: Determines if the validator is running inside a test environment.
